From level %level% you will meet Champion monsters. They are rare, much stronger than their kin, and marked by a colored aura: a blue aura and the title Ultra, a red aura and the title Elite, and the strongest of all with a red aura alone.

Champions have far more HP and hit harder, but give more experience and SP and drop better loot.

Champions also drop the %medal%, which teaches you new buffs and opens the doors of the Survival Arena. The guide will tell you more when you find one.
